name: Engineering Implementation
description: Pick up a Jira story, read the ERD and relevant code, plan the implementation, write the code, run tests, and open a PR.

jiraStoryId.description: Jira story ID to implement (e.g. ACME-456)

nodes.name: Read the story
nodes.description: Read the Jira story. Understand the requirements, acceptance criteria, and any linked ERD or spec. Identify which files will be affected.

nodes.name: Read the relevant code
nodes.description: Read the files most likely affected by this story. Understand the existing patterns, data models, and conventions before writing anything.

nodes.name: Plan the implementation
nodes.description: Write a step-by-step implementation plan. List every file to create or modify, the changes to each, and the test strategy. Be specific — this plan drives all subsequent steps.

nodes.name: Create feature branch
nodes.description: Create a git branch named feat/{jiraStoryId} from the default branch.

nodes.name: Write the implementation
nodes.description: Implement the plan. Write or modify every file listed in the plan. Follow the existing code conventions exactly. Write code that a senior engineer would be proud to merge.

nodes.name: Run the test suite
nodes.description: Run the tests. If they fail, read the failure output, fix the code, and run again. Do not open a PR until tests pass.

nodes.name: Create pull request
nodes.description: Create a PR with a clear title and description. Include: what was changed, why, and how to test it. Link the Jira story in the PR body.
